parts.part: Cards of mixed content, one playing a video with its controls

leaves.what: Each card's insides are composed by hand in src/feed/FeedCards.tsx (recipe, video, tip, collection): media, title as h2, a time line, tags, a footer with the author and two toggles. CardContent is not used. The recipe pictures are tonal blocks with an icon (bg-primary-container and its siblings), standing in for photographs the mock data does not have.
leaves.why: CardContent draws its headline at headline-medium, too large for a feed card at 400px, and has no slot for a meta line, tags or a footer that is not end-aligned actions.

leaves.what: A video player written by hand (src/feed/VideoPlayer.tsx) on a plain <video>: play/pause, seek, time, mute, full screen, pause when scrolled out of view. Its buttons are the kit's IconButton.
leaves.why: The kit has no media player.

leaves.what: The seek bar is React Aria's Slider, SliderTrack and SliderThumb imported from react-aria-components and styled by hand with role utilities, not the kit's Slider.
leaves.why: The kit's Slider draws no filled part of the track (a seek bar is read by its fill), caps its root at max-w-[300px], and lays out a label and an output grid that a seek bar does not want.

leaves.what: Wrapped lucide's Heart and Bookmark in two small components that pass fill="currentColor", and swapped the icon from the toggle's state.
leaves.why: IconButton does not draw a filled icon when selected (its doc comment says so and tells the caller to swap).

leaves.what: Read Card.tsx whole (styles and the root's types) to learn what the root accepts, that classNames.content takes p-0, and how a className background wins over the variant's.
leaves.why: The doc comment covers it, but I had printed the file before reaching it; the tv styles told me the tip card's bg-tertiary-container would merge over the variant.

leaves.what: Read Slider.tsx whole.
leaves.why: Its doc comment is two lines: the missing fill and the 300px cap are only in the styles.

leaves.what: Read IconButton.tsx's prop types past the doc comment.
leaves.why: The doc comment does not say the toggle's props are isSelected and onChange, nor that icon and aria-label are required.

leaves.what: The tip card is drawn tonal by passing className="bg-tertiary-container text-on-tertiary-container" over the filled variant.
leaves.why: Card has three variants and no colour: a tonal card of another role is only reachable by overriding the background.

leaves.what: Read Tag.tsx's styles and the Typography primitives' prop types.
leaves.why: To learn Tag's variant and color names, and that Title/Body/Label take component, colorRole and the element's own attributes (id, role).

parts.notes: The video file (public/media/shakshuka.mp4, H.264 + AAC, 20 s, with a poster) is a synthetic test pattern with a tone, made with ffmpeg on this machine so that play, seek and mute act on a real file. Full screen puts the player's frame (picture and controls) full screen; I am not sure of its layout there. No captions: the clip has no speech. The seek bar's measures are mine (4px track, 16px thumb, 32px tall target), not Material's slider: ds-spec could not be run. The slider's value text is in seconds, not minutes:seconds. Cards are articles in a list, not role=feed. The video does not autoplay: it starts on the Play button or a press on the picture. The time is in font-mono. Verified beyond tsc: a server string-render of the screen and of the cards ran without throwing; nothing was exercised in a browser.

leaves.what: Read Chip.tsx past its doc comment (the FilterChip and ChipGroup bodies and types).
leaves.why: To learn that a filter chip takes id, that ChipGroup passes selectedKeys / onSelectionChange through to ToggleButtonGroup, and that the wrap is hard-coded.

leaves.what: Left the chips wrapping onto two rows at a phone's width.
leaves.why: A feed's chips usually scroll in one row; ChipGroup writes flex-wrap on an inner element that className does not reach, and I did not edit the kit or reach in with a descendant selector.

parts.notes: Multiple selection, AND between chips; a change goes back to the first page and shows the placeholder again. Filtering is done at the mock source, not over the loaded pages. Verified beyond tsc: a server string-render of the screen and of the cards ran without throwing; nothing was exercised in a browser.

leaves.what: Wrote the loading by hand: an IntersectionObserver on a sentinel under the list (600px ahead), remade after each page, not made while a page loads or at the end; two timers stand for the network; an end line when the catalogue is spent.
leaves.why: The skill points to useAsyncList with GridList for a list loaded as it scrolls, but a GridList row is a selectable row and these cards hold controls of their own (a video, toggles); the kit has nothing for a list of cards that loads at its end.

leaves.what: VisuallyHidden from react-aria-components, as a role=status that says loading, how many are loaded, and when all are.
leaves.why: The kit leaves it in React Aria, as its skill says.

leaves.what: Read the end of LoadingIndicator.tsx (the component body).
leaves.why: Its long doc comment is about geometry; that it takes aria-label and a size is only visible in the props.

parts.notes: 18 items plus one video, one collection and four tips, five a page, 0.9 s a page. No failure and retry path is simulated. No 'Load more' button as a fallback where IntersectionObserver is missing. Not exercised in a browser: the observer's behaviour is reasoned, not seen. Verified beyond tsc: a server string-render of the screen and of the cards ran without throwing; nothing was exercised in a browser.

leaves.what: Found the FAB by grepping the kit for 'fab', then read Button.tsx's types and doc comment.
leaves.why: The barrel exports FabMenu and no Fab: nothing in index.ts says the FAB is Button's variant.

leaves.what: Read DialogContent.tsx's and Dialog.tsx's types.
leaves.why: To learn that children replace the title, so the headline is written by hand, and that ModalDialog takes isOpen and onClose.

leaves.what: The dialog's insides are a plain <form> with the kit's fields and two buttons; the FAB is placed by hand: fixed above the bottom bar on a phone, in the rail's header from the md breakpoint.
leaves.why: Expected: composition. The dialog's own actions prop takes labels and onPress, not a submit button.

leaves.what: Wrote the dialog's action row by hand (Cancel, and a Button type="submit") inside the form.
leaves.why: DialogContent's actions take a label and onPress each, or an element, but only without children; with a form as children there is no actions slot, and none that submits.

leaves.what: Read the prop types of TextField, NumberField and Switch, and Snackbar.tsx's region styles with render-props.ts.
leaves.why: To learn the fields' label/suffix/multiline/showCharacterCount props and that Switch's label is its children; and to check that a bottom-* class on SnackbarRegion merges over the region's own bottom-4.

parts.notes: The FAB opens a 'New recipe' dialog; posting puts the recipe at the head of the feed (and under Profile), clears filters it does not match, and says so in a snackbar. Two FABs are rendered and one is hidden by CSS at each width. The snackbar region is moved to bottom-40 on a phone to clear the bar and the FAB. Verified beyond tsc: a server string-render of the screen and of the cards ran without throwing; nothing was exercised in a browser.

leaves.what: Read BottomNavigation.tsx whole and NavigationRail.tsx's styles.
leaves.why: To see how each is placed: neither is fixed by itself, the bar spans its parent and the rail is h-full, so the page fixes them.

leaves.what: The page's shell by hand: the bar fixed at the bottom under md, the rail fixed at the side from md, a sticky top app bar, bottom padding on the content for the bar and the FAB.
leaves.why: Expected: the kit has no app shell.

leaves.what: Read TopAppBar.tsx's styles and prop types.
leaves.why: To see that it is not sticky by itself and takes className for it.

parts.notes: Four destinations held in state, not in the address: no router, so Back does not move between them (kept so because ?dark is in the address). Home is the feed; Saved lists what was bookmarked, with a count badge; Search filters the mock catalogue by dish or cook; Profile lists what the FAB posted. From md up the same destinations are a NavigationRail and the bottom bar is hidden. The Saved badge is left out at zero. Verified beyond tsc: a server string-render of the screen and of the cards ran without throwing; nothing was exercised in a browser.

leaves.what: A card-shaped skeleton by hand (CardPlaceholder): an outlined Card holding bars of bg-on-surface/12, three of them while the first page loads, hidden from assistive technology, with the feed's status saying 'Loading recipes' and aria-busy on the section.
leaves.why: The kit has no skeleton or placeholder component.

leaves.what: Tailwind's animate-pulse (with motion-reduce:animate-none), and on-surface at 12% for the bars.
leaves.why: The kit has no motion token or utility for a loading shimmer, nor a role for a placeholder's fill.

parts.notes: Shown for 1.2 s at the first load and after each change of filters. Loading more pages shows the LoadingIndicator under the list instead. Verified beyond tsc: a server string-render of the screen and of the cards ran without throwing; nothing was exercised in a browser.

leaves.what: Passed media components that ignore the className EmptyState hands them and set size-20 themselves.
leaves.why: EmptyState sizes its media from 128px up to 256px with breakpoint classes and has no prop for it: far too large in a phone's feed.

leaves.what: Read EmptyState.tsx's body.
leaves.why: The doc comment does not say that media is a component type (not a node) nor what size it is drawn at.

parts.notes: Reach it in the feed by choosing 'Desserts' and 'Videos' together (or 'Tips' with any other chip): the first page comes back empty, the state names the filters and its 'Clear filters' button resets them. It is drawn bare (border-0 bg-transparent). The same component is the empty Saved, the empty Profile and a search with no result, each with a working action. Known gap: 'Clear filters' (and un-saving the last card under Saved) removes the button that had focus, so keyboard focus falls back to the page; focus is not moved to the chips. Verified beyond tsc: a server string-render of the screen and of the cards ran without throwing; nothing was exercised in a browser.

friction: The build was green at the first run and no prop was guessed wrong, but only because I read sources: over a dozen kit files past their doc comments (each is a read leave under its part). What was hard: (1) the FAB is not findable from index.ts, which exports FabMenu and no Fab; a line in the barrel or in ds-build ('the FAB is Button variant="fab"') would have saved the grep. (2) Slider's doc comment is two lines and hides that it has no filled track and a 300px cap; a seek bar or any progress-like slider leaves the kit for that. (3) There is no skeleton/placeholder and no token for its motion, though every loading screen needs one. (4) EmptyState's media size cannot be set and grows to 256px. (5) ChipGroup cannot be made a single scrolling row from outside. (6) CardContent's headline-medium makes it unusable for a dense feed card; a size for the headline, or a note in ds-build on composing a card's insides, would help. (7) Nothing in the guidance covers a list of cards loaded at its end: the skill's useAsyncList + GridList row does not fit cards that hold controls. (8) ds-spec could not be run offline, so the hand-made seek bar's measures are not Material's. Easy and well documented: Card's classNames, BottomNavigation / NavigationRail sharing one items shape, the Snackbar doc's note on placing the region above a bar and a FAB, role utilities throughout. Notes that are not leaves: no block was used, since none of the five serves a feed (endless loading has no pager); and a 20-second test-pattern video with a tone and its poster were generated with ffmpeg into public/media, because the screen needs a video that really plays and the web was not allowed.
